plugins.prepareCmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const pkg=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('mobile/package.json','utf8')); pkg.version='${nextRelease.version}'; fs.writeFileSync('mobile/package.json',JSON.stringify(pkg,null,2)+'\n');" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const app=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('mobile/app.json','utf8')); app.expo.version='${nextRelease.version}'; fs.writeFileSync('mobile/app.json',JSON.stringify(app,null,2)+'\n');"
